# Samaria Pet Shop - AI Assistant Repo Guide

Samaria Pet Shop (established 1957 in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India) is a premier certified-healthy pet store, styling studio, and boarding hostel. This file serves as a map for LLMs, developer agents, and AI crawlers navigating this codebase.

## 📁 Repository Structure Overview

- **`/` (Root Folder)**: Public-facing client pages styled using Vanilla CSS (`style.css`) and responsive client interactions (`script.js`).
- **`/admin/`**: Secured backend portal for updating catalogs, reviewing user enquiries, editing blogs, and managing dashboard analytics.
- **`/api/`**: Database endpoints connecting forms and admin portals to the MySQL/MariaDB database server.
- **`/images/`**: Site assets including the logo, brand banners, and animal catalog graphics.

---

## 🧭 Public Sitemap & Routes

- **Homepage (`index.html`)**: Landing page showcasing featured premium pets, client reviews, certification metrics, and services.
- **Adopt Catalogs (`pets.html`)**: Multi-category collection panel for puppies, kittens, birds, and fish:
  - **Dogs (`dogs.html`)**: Certified pedigree puppies with health clearance profiles.
  - **Cats (`cats.html`)**: Premium Persian kittens and British Shorthairs.
  - **Exotic Birds (`birds.html`)**: Interactive cockatoos, budgies, and finches.
  - **Aquariums (`fish.html`)**: Colorful bettas, guppies, and clean tank guides.
  - **Other Small Pets (`other.html`)**: Rabbits, hamsters, and premium feeds.
- **Care Services (`services.html`)**: Full hub detailing operational support facilities:
  - **Hostel Boarding (`boarding.html`)**: Climate-controlled luxury suites with continuous surveillance.
  - **Aesthetic Grooming (`grooming.html`)**: Specialized hydro-baths, detangling, and custom styling.
  - **Obedience Training (`training.html`)**: Certified animal behavior therapy classes.
  - **Vet Assistance (`veterinary.html`)**: Professional clinical examinations and regular vaccination schedules.
- **Guides & Contact**:
  - **Blog hub (`blog.html`)**: Pet-care tips, nutritional instructions, and SEO guides.
  - **Help Desk (`faq.html`)**: Frequently Asked Questions.
  - **Contact Desk (`contact.html`)**: Map directions, WhatsApp buttons, and secure booking fields.

---

## 🛠️ API & Database Design

The system runs on a MySQL database backend (see [setup_database.sql](file:///C:/Users/Lalit/Desktop/project/setup_database.sql) for structure) with PHP integrations:
- **`api/get_pets.php`**: Retrieves listings categorized by species.
- **`api/add_pet.php`**: Registers a new animal record into the system database.
- **`api/delete_pet.php`**: Permanently removes active pet listings from the database.
- **`api/enquiries.php`**: Handles contact submissions and booking queries.
- **`api/get_enquiries.php`**: Lists active pipeline inquiries.
- **`api/update_enquiry_status.php`**: Modifies the pipeline status of a query (`New`, `Contacted`, `Resolved`).
- **`api/blogs.php`**: Handles creation, listing, and deletion of news/blog articles.

---

## 🌐 SEO, Schemas & Discovery Metadata

- **Favicon Icon**: Configured across all pages referencing the brand logo:
  - Root: `images/logo.png`
  - Admin: `../images/logo.png`
- **Structured Schema Markup**: Integrated via dynamic `PetStore` / `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD structures to identify Jaipur, India location metadata.
- **SEO Elements**: Includes clean canonical tags, robot directories (`robots.txt`), Open Graph details, and index priorities.
- **Google Analytics**: Structured Tag placeholders (`G-XXXXXXXXXX`) inside the `<head>` of all HTML files.
